corrections.original: i lov my cat.
corrections.corrected: I love my cat.
corrections.why: We always write "I" as a big letter, and "love" ends with an "e".

corrections.original: she is big
corrections.corrected: She is big.
corrections.why: A sentence starts with a big letter and ends with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: I love my cat. She is big and fluffy. My cat is my best friend.
results.encouragement: Meow-velous work, little writer — GRAMMY loves your cat story!
results.text: i lov my cat. she is big

corrections.original: i hav a red bal.
corrections.corrected: I have a red ball.
corrections.why: We write a big I, and spell the words as have and ball.

corrections.original: i play wit it
corrections.corrected: I play with it.
corrections.why: We write a big I, spell with, and put a full stop at the end.

results.improved_sample: I have a red ball. I play with it. I bounce my ball. I am happy.
results.encouragement: Bounce, bounce, hooray! You are a super little writer!
results.text: i hav a red bal. i play wit it

corrections.original: my mom is good.
corrections.corrected: My mom is good.
corrections.why: A sentence starts with a capital letter, so 'my' becomes 'My'.

corrections.original: she mak food for me.
corrections.corrected: She makes food for me.
corrections.why: Start with a capital 'S', and 'mak' is spelled 'makes'.

corrections.original: i lik her
corrections.corrected: I like her.
corrections.why: 'I' is always a capital letter, 'lik' is spelled 'like', and we end with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: My mom is very kind. She makes yummy food for me. I love her very much.
results.encouragement: Wow, what a loving writer you are! GRAMMY gives you a big golden star! ⭐
results.text: my mom is good. she mak food for me. i lik her

corrections.original: i have a dog.
corrections.corrected: I have a dog.
corrections.why: The word 'I' is always a capital letter.

corrections.original: he is very big and he like to run in the park with me
corrections.corrected: He is very big and he likes to run in the park with me.
corrections.why: Start with a capital 'He', say 'likes' for one dog, and end with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: I have a dog. He is huge and fluffy. He likes to run in the park with me. We race on the green grass. He wags his tail when he is happy. I love my big dog, and he loves me too!
results.encouragement: Woof woof, superstar! GRAMMY loves your doggy story, keep writing and it will grow even bigger!
results.text: i have a dog. he is very big and he like to run in the park with me

corrections.original: Last sunday i go to the zoo with my family.
corrections.corrected: Last Sunday I went to the zoo with my family.
corrections.why: Days and the word 'I' start with capital letters, and we use 'went' for something that already happened.

corrections.original: i saw a big elephant and the monkeys was jumping
corrections.corrected: I saw a big elephant and the monkeys were jumping.
corrections.why: 'I' needs a capital letter, we say 'were' for many monkeys, and a sentence ends with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: Last Sunday, I went to the zoo with my family. I saw a huge, grey elephant with a long trunk. The monkeys were jumping from tree to tree. They looked so funny! It was a very happy day, and I want to go to the zoo again.
results.encouragement: Wow, what a fun zoo trip! Keep writing, little star, your stories are getting better every day!
results.text: Last sunday i go to the zoo with my family. i saw a big elephant and the monkeys was jumping

corrections.original: My favourite festival is diwali.
corrections.corrected: My favourite festival is Diwali.
corrections.why: Names of festivals start with a capital letter.

corrections.original: we lights diyas and eat sweets.
corrections.corrected: We light diyas and eat sweets.
corrections.why: A sentence starts with a capital letter, and with 'we' we say 'light', not 'lights'.

corrections.original: my grandma tell us storys about lord rama
corrections.corrected: My grandma tells us stories about Lord Rama.
corrections.why: Start with a capital 'M', say 'tells' for one grandma, spell 'stories', capitalise 'Lord Rama', and end with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: My favourite festival is Diwali. We light bright diyas all around our home and enjoy yummy sweets. My grandma tells us wonderful stories about Lord Rama. I listen carefully to every word. I love Diwali because it is full of light, sweets and happy stories.
results.encouragement: Your Diwali writing shines as bright as a diya, keep writing, little star!
results.text: My favourite festival is diwali. we lights diyas and eat sweets. my grandma tell us storys about lord rama

corrections.original: Yesterday it rain very heavy in our town.
corrections.corrected: Yesterday it rained very heavily in our town.
corrections.why: Use 'rained' for the past, and 'heavily' to tell how it rained.

corrections.original: The roads was full of water and we cannot go to school.
corrections.corrected: The roads were full of water and we could not go to school.
corrections.why: Use 'were' with 'roads', and 'could not' for the past.

corrections.original: I made paper boats with my brother and we watch them float
corrections.corrected: I made paper boats with my brother and we watched them float.
corrections.why: Use 'watched' for the past and end the sentence with a full stop.

results.improved_sample: Yesterday it rained very heavily in our town. The roads were flooded with water, so we could not go to school. I made paper boats with my brother. We put them in the water and watched them float away. It was the best rainy day ever!
results.encouragement: Splish splash, super writer! Your paper boat story made GRAMMY smile, so keep sailing ahead!
results.text: Yesterday it rain very heavy in our town. The roads was full of water and we cannot go to school. I made paper boats with my brother and we watch them float

corrections.original: If I could fly I would visit every country in the world.
corrections.corrected: If I could fly, I would visit every country in the world.
corrections.why: Add a comma after 'If I could fly' to show a small pause.

corrections.original: First I will go to Japan because I want to see the cherry blossoms, then I would of gone to Egypt to see the pyramids
corrections.corrected: First, I would go to Japan because I want to see the cherry blossoms. Then, I would go to Egypt to see the pyramids.
corrections.why: Change 'will go' and 'would of gone' to 'would go', add commas after 'First' and 'Then', and use full stops to split the long sentence.

results.improved_sample: If I could fly, I would explore every country in the world. First, I would soar to Japan because I want to see the pink cherry blossoms swaying in the breeze. Then, I would fly to Egypt to gaze at the giant pyramids standing tall in the golden desert.
results.encouragement: Your imagination has wings, young writer, so keep flying high with your words!
results.text: If I could fly I would visit every country in the world. First I will go to Japan because I want to see the cherry blossoms, then I would of gone to Egypt to see the pyramids

corrections.original: Plastic pollution is one of the biggest problem today.
corrections.corrected: Plastic pollution is one of the biggest problems today.
corrections.why: After 'one of the', the noun should be plural, so 'problem' becomes 'problems'.

corrections.original: Many animals in the ocean eats plastic thinking it is food.
corrections.corrected: Many animals in the ocean eat plastic, thinking it is food.
corrections.why: 'Animals' is plural, so we use 'eat', and a comma before 'thinking' makes it easier to read.

corrections.original: We should stop using plastic bags and carry cloth bags instead, this small step can make a big difference
corrections.corrected: We should stop using plastic bags and carry cloth bags instead. This small step can make a big difference.
corrections.why: A full stop splits the two complete ideas into two sentences, and another full stop ends the last sentence.

results.improved_sample: Plastic pollution is one of the biggest problems in the world today. Many sea animals, like turtles and fish, eat plastic, thinking it is food, and they become very sick. We should avoid plastic bags and carry cloth bags instead. This simple habit can make a huge difference to our oceans.
results.encouragement: Wonderful thinking, young eco-hero! GRAMMY is proud of you for caring about our oceans!
results.text: Plastic pollution is one of the biggest problem today. Many animals in the ocean eats plastic thinking it is food. We should stop using plastic bags and carry cloth bags instead, this small step can make a big difference

corrections.original: Technology have changed the way students learn.
corrections.corrected: Technology has changed the way students learn.
corrections.why: 'Technology' is singular, so it takes 'has', not 'have'.

corrections.original: Online classes allows us to study from home, however it also cause problems like screen fatigue and less interaction with friends.
corrections.corrected: Online classes allow us to study from home; however, they also cause problems like screen fatigue and less interaction with friends.
corrections.why: Plural 'classes' needs 'allow' and 'they', and 'however' joining two sentences needs a semicolon before it and a comma after it.

corrections.original: In my opinion a balance between online and offline learning is the best approach
corrections.corrected: In my opinion, a balance between online and offline learning is the best approach.
corrections.why: Add a comma after 'In my opinion' and a full stop at the end.

results.improved_sample: Technology has transformed the way students learn. Online classes allow us to study from the comfort of our homes; however, they also bring challenges like screen fatigue and fewer chances to connect with friends. In my opinion, a balance between online and offline learning is the wisest solution, because it gives us the best of both worlds.
results.encouragement: Brilliant thinking, young scholar! Fix those verb matches and your writing will shine like a wizard's wand! ✨
results.text: Technology have changed the way students learn. Online classes allows us to study from home, however it also cause problems like screen fatigue and less interaction with friends. In my opinion a balance between online and offline learning is the best approach
